text: The hand-off marked two criteria partially and one no. CLAUDE.md forbids leaving a new partially unclosed in the same changeset, so both were restated: the verifier criterion is scoped to the result shapes the suite exercises, which a test can establish, and the import-graph criterion is split from the no-repository-access criterion because they fail independently. The genuinely uncheckable one — no figure absent from the record — is checkable: no and says why
